content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that loads a reference depth grid and constructs half-degree geographic coordinates (L4-L10), selects eta files 2 and 9 with displayed hour labels 1 and 8 (L13-L14), then masks eta where dep is negative and creates two stacked surface panels with frame-dependent color limits (L22-L48).
entities: output directory fdir defined at L2
depth matrix dep loaded at L4
matrix dimensions n and m defined at L6
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L7-L8
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L9-L10
selected file vector nfile defined at L13
hour-label cell array hr defined at L14
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L16-L17
loop variable num defined at L22
formatted suffix fnum defined at L24
surface array eta defined at L25 and modified at L27
colorbar handle cbar defined at L44

equations.ref: mask eta wherever reference depth is negative

calls: set at L18, L45, and L46
caxis at L33, L37, and L39
unresolved: Portability defect at L2 and L25: eta files are read from a developer-specific absolute directory, with no runtime input or existence check.
Cross-array shape assumption at L4-L10 and L25-L31: eta is indexed by a mask derived from dep and plotted on dep-derived coordinates without checking that their dimensions match.
The caxis call at L33 is unconditionally overwritten for every iteration by L36-L40, so its [-0.1,0.1] setting is ineffective.

The independent arrays nfile and hr at L13-L14 are indexed by the same num at L24 and L34 but their equal lengths are not checked; editing only one produces an out-of-range hr access or unlabeled selections.
MATLAB pcolor at L31 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; no compensation is present if full-grid coverage is intended.
